info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries-v2-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Beneficiaries Listing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of beneficiaries associated with their banking accounts. This endpoint facilitates the management of beneficiaries, allowing financial institutions and customers to easily view and verify account details. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and financial service providers that require access to beneficiary information for various operational needs. By offering streamlined access to beneficiary data, it enhances user experience and supports efficient account management.

get.description: Fetches the list of beneficiaries associated with the specified account. This endpoint allows you to obtain detailed information about each beneficiary linked to the account, including their names and relevant contact information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with the account. Ensure that all required parameters are correctly included to successfully fetch the data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of beneficiaries.
